  tagline = 'Unleash the power behind the armor.',
  description = 'When Tony Stark''s world is torn apart by a formidable terrorist called the Mandarin, he starts an odyssey of rebuilding and retribution. Stripped of his armor and forced to rely on his ingenuity, Stark must protect those closest to him as he seeks to destroy the Mandarin and find the person responsible for the Extremis attacks.',

  rtAudienceScore = 78,
  verdict = 'hit',
  cardMarketContent = '## Iron Man 3: The Billion Dollar Card Set

Iron Man 3 (2013) became the first solo MCU film to cross $1 billion worldwide, and the **2013 Upper Deck Iron Man 3** trading card set reflects that massive popularity. This set is considered one of the most comprehensive MCU movie card sets ever produced.

### Key Sets

The **2013 Rittenhouse Iron Man 3** set features autographs from the principal cast, including Robert Downey Jr., Guy Pearce, and Ben Kingsley. The set also introduced the popular "Hall of Armor" insert series showcasing all of Tony''s suits from Mark I through Mark XLII.

### Market Trends

RDJ autograph cards from this set remain among the most valuable in the hobby ($5,000+). The "Hall of Armor" inserts have developed a dedicated following among collectors who appreciate the suit progression. Guy Pearce and Ben Kingsley autographs are more affordable entry points for Iron Man collectors.',
  keyCards = '- **2013 Rittenhouse Iron Man 3 RDJ Autograph** — Premium auto card from the billion-dollar film ($5,000+)
- **Hall of Armor Insert Set** — Complete suit progression from Mark I to Mark XLII
- **Ben Kingsley as The Mandarin Auto** — Controversial twist makes this card a conversation piece ($400+)
- **Guy Pearce as Killian Autograph** — Underrated villain card ($300+)
- **2013 Rittenhouse Iron Man 3 Sketch Cards** — Original 1/1 artwork
- **Gwyneth Paltrow as Pepper Potts Costume Card** — Screen-worn memorabilia',
  content = '## Tony Stark Without the Suit

Iron Man 3 asked a simple but profound question: who is Tony Stark without the armor? Director Shane Black (who wrote Lethal Weapon) brought his signature wit and noir sensibility to the MCU, creating a film that''s equal parts action spectacle and character study. The result was the first solo MCU film to cross $1 billion worldwide.

## The Legacy

- **First Solo MCU Billion-Dollar Film** — $1.215 billion proved Iron Man''s solo drawing power
- **The Mandarin Twist** — One of the MCU''s most controversial and talked-about plot twists
- **Tony''s PTSD** — First MCU film to seriously address the psychological toll of being a superhero
- **The House Party Protocol** — The climactic scene with 40+ Iron Man suits remains visually stunning
- **Pepper Gets Powers** — Gwyneth Paltrow''s Pepper Potts became more than a love interest

## Fun Facts

- Shane Black set the film at Christmas because he sets all his films at Christmas (Lethal Weapon, Kiss Kiss Bang Bang)
- The Mandarin twist was so controversial that Marvel made a short film (All Hail the King) to address fan backlash
- Robert Downey Jr. earned $75 million from this film alone
- The "House Party Protocol" sequence required over 2,000 VFX shots
- Ben Kingsley learned to do a perfect American accent for the Mandarin scenes

## Viewing Context

Iron Man 3 is the **seventh MCU film** and the first film of Phase 2. It takes place after The Avengers and deals directly with Tony''s trauma from the Battle of New York. It''s the final solo Iron Man film in the franchise.',
  metaDescription = 'Iron Man 3 (2013) MCU guide — $1.2B box office, the Mandarin twist, trading card market analysis, and why this billion-dollar film matters for collectors.',
  keywords = 'Iron Man 3, MCU Phase 2, Tony Stark, Mandarin, billion dollar, trading cards, Marvel cards, Rittenhouse, box office, Shane Black',
  ebaySearchTerm = 'Topps Marvel Iron Man cards',
  faqData = '[{"question":"Is Iron Man 3 on Disney+?","answer":"Yes, Iron Man 3 (2013) is available on Disney+. It is the seventh MCU film and the first entry in Phase 2, taking place after The Avengers."},{"question":"How much did Iron Man 3 make at the box office?","answer":"Iron Man 3 grossed $1.215 billion worldwide against a $200 million budget, making it the first solo MCU film to cross $1 billion. It earned $174 million opening weekend domestically."},{"question":"What is the Mandarin twist in Iron Man 3?","answer":"The Mandarin twist reveals that Ben Kingsley''s character is actually an actor named Trevor Slattery hired to play a terrorist. The real villain is Aldrich Killian (Guy Pearce), who created the Mandarin persona as a cover for his Extremis experiments."},{"question":"What Iron Man 3 cards are valuable?","answer":"The most valuable include Robert Downey Jr. autographs ($5,000+), the complete Hall of Armor insert set, Ben Kingsley Mandarin autos ($400+), and 2013 Rittenhouse sketch cards. RDJ autos from any Iron Man set remain the holy grail of MCU collecting."},{"question":"Is Iron Man 3 the last Iron Man movie?","answer":"Yes, Iron Man 3 (2013) is the final solo Iron Man film. Tony Stark continued to appear in Avengers: Age of Ultron, Captain America: Civil War, Spider-Man: Homecoming, Avengers: Infinity War, and Avengers: Endgame."}]',
  status = 'published',
  updatedAt = NOW()
WHERE slug = 'iron-man-3-2013'
